analysis.title: Market Internal Insight: FOMC Non-Event; RM Support Intact; Excess Buy Flow & Barbell Outperformance in AI/QQQ and High-Short-Interest/IWM
key_insights: FOMC day on Oct 28 was a non-event for flows. Excess flow was below $20 bn, so it did not challenge the author's bullish view or trigger volatility.
Index moves were small (SPX +0.3%, QQQ +0.6%), but factor moves were large: AI Semis +2.5%, UBXXSHRT (Short Interest Basket) +1.6%, AI Power +1.3%.
The author expects QQQ to benefit from the tech rally and IWM to benefit from a short squeeze.
Excess buy flow was +$13 bn in the S&P 500 and +$10 bn in Nasdaq. Nasdaq saw +$2 bn before 2pm and +$8 bn after 2pm, a post-FOMC preference for tech.
Pre-FOMC volume was light: cash, futures and ETF volume ran at 78%, 69% and 31% of average.
Real money support is intact. UBS RMM clients bought at the 78th percentile vs 3Y, with buy tilt in Telecom, Semis and ETFs and sell tilt in Energy, Tech and Financials.
Foreign listed US ETFs saw inflows on 12 of 12 days and 25 of the last 26 days since Sep 23, at +1x to +1.7x standard deviation recently, recovering from the September quarter-end seasonal low.
CTA positioning: RTY1 exposure is at the 10th percentile vs 3Y with 6 close buy triggers within +3.5% and no close sell trigger, giving the biggest CTA upside potential plus short squeeze risk.

ES1 CTA exposure is at the 79th percentile vs 3Y with 2 close buy triggers and 5 close sell triggers within -3%. NQ1 exposure is at the 34th percentile with 3 close buy triggers and no close sell trigger.

SPX dealer gamma swung between -$25 bn and +$20 bn intraday over the last 2 days. Long gamma above +$15 bn constrained SPX moves, while the drop below -$15 bn (typically after 3:30pm) amplified end-of-day volatility.

risk_factors: Dealer gamma collapsing below -$15 bn late in the session has amplified end-of-day volatility.
ES1 has 5 close CTA sell triggers within -3%, with the nearest at 7737.9 (-0.6%).

vol_and_positioning: SPX dealer gamma fell to a low of -$25 bn at 3:50pm on Oct 27 and to -$20 bn at 3:50pm on Oct 28. Gamma was long above +$12 bn between 1:40pm and 3:10pm on Oct 27.
Intraday long gamma above +$15 bn constrained SPX moves. The collapse below -$15 bn, typically after 3:30pm, amplified end-of-day volatility on both days.
CTA NQ1 buy triggers: 30356 (ST +1.3%), 30480 (LT +1.7%), 30522 (MT +1.8%). First sell trigger is 28955 (ST -3.4%).
The UBXXSHRT short interest basket rose 1.6%, supporting the short squeeze view for IWM.
